summary: Paramount Skydance Corporation files Form 8-K to recast historical segment information for August 7–December 31, 2025, aligning with a new three-segment structure (Studios, Direct-to-Consumer, TV Media) effective 2026. The recast reflects a combination of historical Filmed Entertainment and TV Media studio operations into Studios, and the move of Paramount+ with Showtime from TV Media to Direct-to-Consumer. Segment expense allocations were updated, and centralized costs moved to corporate. This is an accounting change, not a special situation. No deal terms, board recommendation, or advisors are mentioned. No regulatory or structural mechanics are involved.
